subject.title: Gateway silently skips channel initialization on plugin/runtime mismatch or missing module files

question: Should this issue be narrowed to a gateway configured-channel initialization audit, or should it also include fail-fast plugin compatibility, hot plugin reload, API timeout severity, and startup performance changes?
rationale: Repository policy treats gateway/plugin metadata as process-stable and plugin/config/startup behavior as compatibility-sensitive, so automation should not choose fail-fast versus warn-and-continue or hot reload semantics on its own.

options.title: Narrow to channel audit
options.body: Implement a startup/status audit that names configured channels attempted, loaded, and failed before registration, and track the broader requests separately.

options.title: Broader startup contract
options.body: Keep this issue as the umbrella for audit logging, compatibility gates, API timeout severity, hot reload, and startup performance, accepting a larger design/review cycle.

options.title: Fold into adjacent observability work
options.body: Make a broader observability issue the canonical owner and close this only after its channel-specific requirements are explicitly preserved there.

recommendation.title: Narrow to channel audit
recommendation.body: Implement a startup/status audit that names configured channels attempted, loaded, and failed before registration, and track the broader requests separately.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame places the relevant gateway/channel/plugin diagnostic surfaces on recent work by this owner, making them the best routing candidate for the product boundary choice.
